name: Slim-pivot regressive desmo: stage-1 groove inside hub 2's O20 (cells B / A / T)
family: slaved-knuckle 3R, spring-free desmo K drive (desmo-window's buildable level, new drive geometry)
verdict: DEAD by the pre-registered kill rule: with the stage-1 ring inside the O20 rim (pitch_hi <= 8.44) no pin passes even the NOMINAL built-groove pressure-angle gate over 108 crank geometries x ~7800 pins (cells B mu 0.15 and A mu 0.087; min built PA of in-rim pins 43.9 vs gates 34.47 / 38.03); the closest PA-feasible pins stick 0.40-0.50 mm past the rim (pitch_hi 8.84-8.93) at nominal rc 0.67-0.83 < 1.0; cell T (0.6 wall, pitch <= 8.64, rc >= 1.3) dies on the same numbers. The proposer's start 1 reads built PA 48.5 / rc 0.68 in the claim model (drive cut at K 0). Variant W (same drive geometry, ring past the rim at kit density, robust rc gate held) reads fast 12.87 plain / 18.80 near-touch (k22), level with desmo-window's kit-density 13.26 / 19.02; not worn.
limiter: stage-1 geometry: the groove level is fixed by the stack (mid F2+3.9) and the O8 crank boss holds the crank axis >= ~15 mm from u2 there, so a pin <= 8.44 mm from u2 is turned tangentially about u2 (the cap ring's own direction) and its built pressure angle exceeds 43 deg; in variant W the window wall over the MR117 seat (>= 0.8 needs pitch_lo >= ~7.4) and the crank's 132 samples at 0.80 in band (unchanged by dR / g) hold in-band at desmo-window's level
note: Exhaustive feasibility grid, not an optimiser: the convergence gate is not the basis (n/a / n/a / n/a); variant-W fast sweep not converged (time box, 8 valid rows). Model control reproduces desmo-window k4 (14.68 / 20.52) and its death audit's ringfix (19.02, ib14 0.8924); stage-1 replica validated vs the model (rc 0.895 vs 0.89, pitch 9.851, drift 0.296 vs 0.297). desmo-window's own pin fails the judge's robust rc gate (0.891 nominal). Rows k0-k11 invalid (pre-fix: the parent clamp zeroed cprog). Saved: docs/concepts/verify/desmo-geom-knuckle-3r_s1grid_inrim.json, _s1grid_window.json.

mechanism.notes: desmo-window's record with the crank pivot on 2 x MR52ZZ (O8 boss) instead of 2 x MR63ZZ: count-neutral; no body, joint, loop or sliding pair added
